Right-hand middle-order batsman. Originally from Pakistan, he was
a  prolific scorer for Karachi during the mid-80s. A quickfire 53
in 47 balls versus Pakistan A, in the 4 Nation Interface  Cup  in
December `95, indicates his usefulness to the side.
